A decade is a period of ten years.
To postpone something is to arrange for it to happen later.
Purchase means to buy or acquire something.
To verify information is to check and confirm that it is correct.
Approximately means about or roughly, not exactly.
Assist means to help or support someone.
A feasible plan is possible and practical to carry out.
Cautious means careful to avoid danger, mistakes, or unnecessary risks.
Someone who is eligible meets the conditions required for something.
Sufficient means enough for a particular purpose; adequate.
To allocate resources is to assign or distribute them for a purpose.
A durable product is designed to last for a long time.
An impartial person does not favor one side; they are unbiased.
To amend a document is to make changes or revise it.
In a business context, complimentary means provided free of charge.
A reimbursement is repayment for money someone has spent.
Mandatory means required by a rule or authority; compulsory.
Adjacent means next to or directly beside something.
To retain something is to keep or continue to have it.
To obtain something is to get or acquire it.
To initiate a process is to start or set it in motion.
Notable means worthy of attention or remarkable.
Frequently means often or at short intervals.
To expand is to grow; to contract is to become smaller.
Permanent means lasting or intended to last indefinitely, the opposite of temporary.
Optional means a choice, not something required.
A vacant office is empty; an occupied one is in use.
To decrease is to become smaller or less, the opposite of increase.
To relinquish is to give up or let go of something you have retained.
An efficient process avoids wasted time or resources; a wasteful one does not.
Prior means earlier; subsequent means later or following.
Occasional means happening from time to time, not frequently.
Opaque means not transparent or not allowing light to pass through.
Someone who is eager is enthusiastic or willing, the opposite of reluctant.
A surplus is more than needed; a shortage is less than needed.
To deteriorate is to become worse; to improve is to become better.
To reject a proposal is to refuse to approve it.
Public information is open to everyone, unlike confidential information.
To maximize is to make as large or great as possible, the opposite of minimize.
Preliminary means coming before the main event; final means last or conclusive.
Rigid means stiff or not easily changed, unlike flexible.
A pessimistic person expects negative outcomes; an optimistic person expects positive ones.
Stingy means unwilling to give or spend; it is the opposite of generous.
To decline an invitation or offer is to refuse it, the opposite of accepting it.
To decelerate is to slow down, the opposite of accelerate.
Unsatisfactory means not good enough or not meeting expectations.
